def pathinfo(cells):
    s=set(cells)
    corner=None
    for p in cells:
        nb=[(p[0]+dy,p[1]+dx) in s for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
        if sum(nb)==2 and not(nb[0] and nb[1]) and not(nb[2] and nb[3]):

            if (nb[0] or nb[1]) and (nb[2] or nb[3]): corner=p
    d1v=(1 if (corner[0]+1,corner[1]) in s else -1,0)
    d2v=(0,1 if (corner[0],corner[1]+1) in s else -1)
    return corner,d1v,d2v
def inside(corner,u,v,cells):
    # interior direction = -u - v ; object inside if its centroid is within the rectangle spanned by arms from corner toward -u and -v

def transform3(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=_objects(g,bg)
    paths=[(len(c),c) for c in (cs for _,cs in objs) if _is_path(c)]
    pl,pcells=max(paths)
    corner,u,v=pathinfo(pcells)
    target=pcells[0] and g[corner[0]][corner[1]]
    groups={}
    for col,cells in objs: groups.setdefault(_norm(cells),[]).append((col,cells))
    size,members=max((len(k),vv) for k,vv in groups.items() if len(vv)>1)
    cents=[(sum(p[0] for p in c)/len(c), sum(p[1] for p in c)/len(c), col, c) for col,c in members]
    ds=[(1 if cy>corner[0] else -1 if cy<corner[0] else 0, 1 if cx>corner[1] else -1 if cx<corner[1] else 0) for cy,cx,_,_ in cents]
    a=ds[0]; b=ds[1]
    diffaxis = 0 if a[0]!=b[0] else 1
    arms=[u,v]
    arm=[d for d in arms if d[diffaxis]!=0][0]
    sign=arm[diffaxis]
    for i,(dd,(cy,cx,col,c)) in enumerate(zip(ds,cents)):
        if dd[diffaxis]!=sign:
            for (y,x) in c: g[y][x]=g[corner[0]][corner[1]]
    return g
